segments.he: הַשִּׂיחָה הַנִּדְפֶּסֶת בְּסוֹף סִפּוּרֵי-מַעֲשִׂיּוֹת (שִׂיחוֹת הָרַ"ן נ"ח) הַמַּתְחֶלֶת יֵשׁ דָּבָר שֶׁפּוֹרֵחַ בַּמַּחֲשָׁבָה, זאת הַשִּׂיחָה שָׁמַעְתִּי מִמֶּנּוּ עַל
segments.en: (1.) In the year 5565 [1804/5]: I was standing near the table and swimming in the sea — and all the nations and all the kings stood and watched and marveled — [meaning] the table of kings, the sea of wisdom, that I would reveal wisdom such as even etc.
